title: Filtration Content across Maintenance Agreements, Energy Subscriptions and the Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs
content:
**Desk rule.** Filtration is either bought under the Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs or inside the maintenance agreement, never twice. Where the building holds a maintenance agreement whose tier already includes filter change visits, this program is quoted only for the content the agreement does not carry — coil hygiene, purification, testing or certification — and the filter sets stay on the agreement. A building that takes filtration here does not hold the maintenance entry tier, whose whole content is filter and belt service. Where the filter change finds a mechanical fault, the fault is passed to the maintenance agreement or quoted as demand service rather than worked on this program's visit. Where an energy subscription flags a pressure drop that a filter change would clear, the change is performed from this program's credit and the energy subscription is not billed for it.

### What the desk reads before a quote

The maintenance agreement held at the building is read from the company's maintenance agreement records for that same building: its status and its tier. An agreement in active, pending renewal or suspended status is the agreement read for this rule. Whether that agreement's tier includes filter change visits decides what this program may be quoted for at the building.

| Maintenance agreement at the building | What this program is quoted for |
|---|---|
| None in active, pending renewal or suspended status | The tier's full content |
| Held, and its tier does not include filter change visits | The tier's full content |
| Held, and its tier includes filter change visits | Only the content the agreement does not carry: coil hygiene, purification, testing or certification; the filter sets stay on the agreement |

### The maintenance entry tier

A building that takes filtration under this program does not hold the maintenance entry tier, the tier of the maintenance agreements whose whole content is filter and belt service.

### Faults found and pressure drops flagged

| Situation at a filter change | Treatment |
|---|---|
| A mechanical fault is found | Passed to the maintenance agreement, or quoted as demand service; not worked on this program's visit |
| An energy subscription flags a pressure drop a filter change would clear | The change is performed from this program's filter credit; the energy subscription is not billed for it |
